description.Fa: به منظور مشاهده جزئیات کامل و ثبت سفارش، لازم است در سامانه «زرپلاس»—شبکه تخصصی گالری‌های معتبر طرف قرارداد—نام‌نویسی نمایید. پس از تکمیل فرآیند عضویت که کمتر از ۵ دقیقه به طول می‌انجامد، پنل اختصاصی شما فعال شده و امکان بررسی دقیق محصولات فراهم خواهد شد.
description.En: In order to view full details and place an order, you need to register in the ZarPlus system — a specialized network of trusted contracted galleries. After completing the registration process, which takes less than 5 minutes, your dedicated panel will be activated and you will be able to review products in detail.
description.Tu: In order to view full details and place an order, you need to register in the ZarPlus system — a specialized network of trusted contracted galleries. After completing the registration process, which takes less than 5 minutes, your dedicated panel will be activated and you will be able to review products in detail.

features.Fa: زرپلاس علاوه بر ایجاد سهولت در خرید، بستری هوشمند برای رشد چشمگیر فروش گالری شماست. جهت آشنایی با خدمات، ماه نخست عضویت کاملاً رایگان بوده و هیچ هزینه‌ای دریافت نمی‌گردد.
features.En: In addition to making purchases easier, ZarPlus is a smart platform for significant growth in your gallery's sales. To get familiar with the services, the first month of membership is completely free and no fees are charged.
features.Tu: In addition to making purchases easier, ZarPlus is a smart platform for significant growth in your gallery's sales. To get familiar with the services, the first month of membership is completely free and no fees are charged.

purchase_notif.Fa: به منظور مشاهده جزئیات کامل و ثبت سفارش، لازم است در صفحه‌ی ویژه‌ی ویترین‌دارها درخواست ثبت نمایید تا در کوتاه‌ترین زمان ممکن با شما تماس بگیریم.
purchase_notif.En: In order to view full details and place an order, you need to submit a request on the dedicated showcase owners page so that we can contact you as soon as possible.
purchase_notif.Tu: In order to view full details and place an order, you need to submit a request on the dedicated showcase owners page so that we can contact you as soon as possible.

request_access_title.Fa: درخواست مشاهده و سفارش از بنکداری
request_access_title.En: Request to view and order from wholesaler
request_access_title.Tu: Request to view and order from wholesaler

request_access_description.Fa: پس از تایید دسترسی گالری شما توسط بنکداری، دسترسی شما به مشاهده جزئیات و سفارش از بنکداری فعال می‌شود.
request_access_description.En: After your gallery access is approved by the wholesaler, your access to view details and order from the wholesaler will be activated.
request_access_description.Tu: After your gallery access is approved by the wholesaler, your access to view details and order from the wholesaler will be activated.
